setup.title: Welcome to CineApp
setup.subtitle: A few settings and your cinema is ready.

welcome.text: This assistant helps you connect CineApp to your services. It stays open until you click “Finish”: you can leave and come back.
welcome.urls: Addresses are seen from inside the container: on a shared Docker network, use the container name (http://radarr:7878); otherwise the server's IP address. “localhost” means the container itself.
welcome.env: A value already present in your .env fills its field automatically.

admin.title: Create the administrator account
admin.text: This local account opens the management area and these settings, even when Jellyfin is unreachable.
admin.invalidUsername: Letters, digits, dot, dash, at sign or underscore — 64 at most.

jellyfin.title: Jellyfin
jellyfin.why: Required: Jellyfin plays the films, knows the accounts and keeps playback positions.

tmdb.why: Required: posters, synopses, cast and suggestions come from TMDB.
tmdb.help: Free key: themoviedb.org → Settings → API (“API Key”).

radarr.title: Radarr
radarr.why: Optional. Manages movies: downloads, requests, file quality. Without it, the cinema shows the movies Jellyfin has.
radarr.help: Key: Radarr → Settings → General → API Key.

sonarr.title: Sonarr
sonarr.why: Optional. Manages series: downloads, requests, missing episodes. Without it, the cinema shows the series Jellyfin has.
sonarr.help: Key: Sonarr → Settings → General → API Key.

jellyseerr.title: Jellyseerr
jellyseerr.why: Request a film or series that isn't there yet, and follow its arrival.
jellyseerr.help: Key: Jellyseerr → Settings → General → API Key.

qbittorrent.title: qBittorrent
qbittorrent.why: Shows the progress of current downloads.
qbittorrent.help: The credentials of qBittorrent's web interface.

bazarr.title: Bazarr
bazarr.why: Searches and manages subtitles from the management area.
bazarr.help: Key: Bazarr → Settings → General → API Key.

jackett.title: Jackett
jackett.why: Indexer status, shown in the management area.
jackett.help: Key: at the top of Jackett's page.

ratings.title: Ratings
ratings.why: IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic ratings on title pages.

app.title: Application
app.why: Poster preparation and the contact address for notifications.

defaults.title: Default settings
defaults.why: What an account sees until it chooses otherwise. Everyone can change it for themselves in Account (Language, Interface).
defaults.whyLanguage: The language of the sign-in page and of every account that has not chosen one. Everyone can change it for themselves in Account → Language.

deployment.title: Deployment options
deployment.why: These options are set when the container starts: add the line shown to your docker-compose.yml (or your .env), then restart the container.

playback.title: Playback
playback.why: The built-in player plays films in the browser. When a file won't play (a sound or picture the device can't decode), it hands it over to Jellyfin, which converts it on the fly — on by default, recommended. Turned off, those files show a playback error, and the server never converts anything.

subtitles.title: Generated subtitles
subtitles.why: Translates a full subtitle of the title into the chosen language on demand, during playback, with an online AI. Without a key, the feature appears nowhere.
subtitles.help: The key stays on the server: it is never sent to devices nor written to the logs.

dialogue.title: Dialogue search
dialogue.why: Reads the films' subtitles so they can be searched by a line.

gesture.title: Suggested action
gesture.jellyfinIdentifyMovie: Jellyfin → the movie → ⋮ → Identify → TMDB {tmdb} ({title}), then Refresh metadata replacing everything.
gesture.jellyfinIdentifySeries: Jellyfin → the series → ⋮ → Identify → TVDB {tvdb} / TMDB {tmdb} ({title}), then Refresh metadata replacing everything.
gesture.radarrReplace: Radarr → {title} → Files: check this file. If it is another movie, delete it and search again — or attach it to the right movie through Wanted → Manual Import.
gesture.sonarrFixIdentity: Sonarr → {title} → Edit: check the tracked series. If the folder holds {jellyfin}, remove it from Sonarr and import the folder under the right series (Library Import) — or trust Jellyfin for episode names.
gesture.identityUnknown: Open the title in Jellyfin and compare it with {service}. If Jellyfin is wrong: Identify → TMDB {tmdb}. If {service} is: fix the tracked title or replace the file.
gesture.numberingJellyfin: The disk follows TMDB's order: turn on “Trust Jellyfin” — or in Sonarr → {title} → Edit, change the series type (Standard / Anime) then rename the files.
gesture.numberingSonarr: Sonarr names these files correctly: the cinema already shows its names. To align the disk: Sonarr → {title} → Rename files.
gesture.numberingUnknown: Compare a few episodes on screen. If the names shown in the cinema are wrong, turn on “Trust Jellyfin”; otherwise, nothing to do.
gesture.radarrImport: To track it: Radarr → Movies → Library Import, folder {folder}.
gesture.sonarrImport: To track it: Sonarr → Series → Library Import, folder {folder}.
gesture.noService: {service} is not configured: this is normal.
gesture.hardlinks: If this double is not intended, remove one of the two titles from Radarr or Sonarr (deleting that title's files only).

trust.listHint: These series keep Jellyfin's episode names and summaries in the cinema.

integrity.title: File integrity
integrity.hint: Reads every video file in the library (films and episodes) again with the cinema's own player, and lists those containing an unreadable stretch. One read at a time, paused while someone watches, never alongside the quote indexing. The first pass is long; after that, only new or changed files are read, every night.

phase.waiting-disk: Waiting: the quote indexing is reading the disks

integrity.counts: {ok} sound · {damaged} damaged · {unsupported} MP4 not checked · {error} unreadable
integrity.nightly: new files are checked every night
integrity.truncated: More stretches than the list shows.
integrity.unreachableTail: The end of the file could not be read (no index point after the stretch).
integrity.unreadable: Files that could not be read ({n})
integrity.actionFailed: The action did not go through.
